description: Creates an API key on the connected account for the user's server to call the REST API with, and returns it once. Create one only when the user asks for it or the integration needs it; keys are listed and revoked in the dashboard. While building or testing an integration, create a test key: it answers from fictional people and companies, never reaches a registry, and is never billed.

name.description: A label to tell the key apart, e.g. "Production".

test.description: true for a test key (rfc_test_...), which returns fictional data for the documented test identifiers. Default false.

name: create_api_key
title: Create an API key
